entity: Roosevelt Cayman Asset Company's share of Puerto Rico federal foreclosure filings and default judgments
what_we_add: the default-judgment rate: 52% of first filings vs 37% for other filers, and the ~1,130 case count over 2015-25
why: NotiCel, Hedge Clippers and The Intercept all name Roosevelt Cayman as the dominant federal-foreclosure filer in Puerto Rico, same direction. The Intercept notes default-judgment motions but nobody has the 52%-vs-37% rate.
